goals.gate: All 11 capability gates passed with artifacts under artifacts/a11y/<slug>/

gates.name: 0.1 Startup phrase spoken and session type declared before any w
gates.description: Startup phrase spoken and session type declared before any work begins

gates.name: 0.2 RIG operating procedures loaded and declared mandatory for t
gates.description: RIG operating procedures loaded and declared mandatory for this session

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple declared verbatim: H_accessibility_audit(ident
gates.description: Harness tuple declared verbatim: H_accessibility_audit(identity, gates, dod, failure_protocol, self_improvement)

gates.name: 0.5 Goal-card for the session written to artifacts/<session>/goa
gates.description: Goal-card for the session written to artifacts/<session>/goal-card.yaml with an executable done_test

gates.name: 1.1 Scope and conformance target declared: URL/route list, WCAG
gates.description: Scope and conformance target declared: URL/route list, WCAG 2.2 level AA minimum
gates.command: artifacts/a11y/<slug>/scope.yaml with route list and conformance level; every scanned page maps to a scope entry

gates.name: 1.2 Automated scan run on every scoped route with results preser
gates.description: Automated scan run on every scoped route with results preserved
gates.command: `npx axe <route> --save artifacts/a11y/<slug>/axe/<route>.json` (or pa11y equivalent) per route; violation counts summarized by impact

gates.name: 1.3 Contrast computation executed programmatically for all text/
gates.description: Contrast computation executed programmatically for all text/background pairs in the rendered pages
gates.command: `node scripts/contrast-audit.mjs <routes>` output table; every failing pair listed with measured ratio vs required (4.5:1 / 3:1)

gates.name: 2.1 Keyboard-only walkthrough: every interactive element reachab
gates.description: Keyboard-only walkthrough: every interactive element reachable and operable; tab order matches visual order; zero keyboard traps
gates.command: artifacts/a11y/<slug>/keyboard-log.md per route: element count tabbed vs interactive count in DOM; trap check = none found

gates.name: 2.2 Screen reader pass (VoiceOver or NVDA) on critical flows wit
gates.description: Screen reader pass (VoiceOver or NVDA) on critical flows with announcement log
gates.command: artifacts/a11y/<slug>/sr-log.md: per-step actual announcement vs expected; mismatches filed as findings

gates.name: 2.3 Visible focus indicator verified on every focusable element
gates.description: Visible focus indicator verified on every focusable element (not suppressed by CSS)
gates.command: `grep -rn 'outline: *none\|outline: *0' src --include='*.css'` hits all paired with a replacement focus style or filed as findings

gates.name: 2.4 Reduced-motion and zoom/reflow checks: prefers-reduced-motio
gates.description: Reduced-motion and zoom/reflow checks: prefers-reduced-motion honored; usable at 200% zoom / 320px reflow
gates.command: emulated-media test artifacts: screenshots at 200% zoom + `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` render in artifacts/a11y/<slug>/

gates.name: 2.5 Forms audited: every input has a programmatic label; errors
gates.description: Forms audited: every input has a programmatic label; errors are associated via aria-describedby and announced
gates.command: form inventory table: input count vs labeled count equal; error-announcement evidence in sr-log.md

gates.name: 3.1 Findings report maps every issue to a WCAG 2.2 success crite
gates.description: Findings report maps every issue to a WCAG 2.2 success criterion and severity
gates.command: artifacts/a11y/<slug>/report.md: criterion ID + severity + evidence link per finding; zero unmapped findings

gates.name: 3.2 Remediation tickets filed for all critical/serious findings
gates.description: Remediation tickets filed for all critical/serious findings with reproduction steps
gates.command: ticket list in report appendix (issue IDs or local tickets.yaml); each cites finding ID and repro path

gates.name: 3.3 Re-test criteria stated per finding so fixes are verifiable,
gates.description: Re-test criteria stated per finding so fixes are verifiable, not vibes
gates.command: every finding carries a 'verified by' line naming the command or manual check that proves the fix

preconditions.startup_phrase: Accessibility audit mode: WCAG 2.2 AA is the floor, assistive-tech evidence is the proof.
preconditions.bms_bias: A1-A2 preferred; A3 permitted for remediation design; A4 only with approval

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times across sessions

success_conditions: All 11 capability gates passed with artifacts under artifacts/a11y/<slug>/
Primary objective achieved: WCAG-criterion-mapped findings report with remediation and re-test criteria
Assistive-tech evidence (keyboard + screen reader logs) exists for every critical flow
Identity closure: coordinate, verdict, and next safe action stated
failure_states: halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 3.1: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 2.4, 2.5, 3.2, 3.3: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver

Outward action (publish, send, deploy) requires Gate-D approval — v0 is local-only.
Every accessibility-audit-session session leaves the system stronger than it found it.
